subject: Runtime headcount: request for Senior Runtime Engineer + band exception / slot swap
content:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Runtime headcount request — Senior Runtime Engineer (low-latency) + band exception / slot swap

Hi team,

Requesting approval to open a Senior Runtime Engineer (low-latency primitives) role for Q3. This hire is directly tied to the projected GA for the continuous KV caching feature and the expected 30% increase in production token throughput for our mid-market customers. Without additional headcount we expect increased tail latency incidents and throttling that will materially impact SLAs for Dedicated customers.

Summary:
- Role: Senior Runtime Engineer (infra/runtime)
- Team: Runtime Core (reporting to me)
- T-shirt impact: +1 FTE (IC4 / senior)
- Proposed compensation band: Band 5 (base range $170k–$210k; total comp target up to $300k with equity + bonus)
- Rationale: Urgent capacity and low-latency kernel work; need senior-level ownership for KV cache correctness and kernel fusion roadmap
- Proposed financing: swap one open infra slot currently allocated to Edge Serving (2nd quarter deferred hire) into Runtime Core; net headcount remains unchanged for Q3 budget.

Attached: runtime_hc_request_rafael_v1.pdf (request doc) and q3_capacity_impact.ods (forecast). Also linked the JIRA for the KV cache rollout (JIRA-OPS-1287).

Ask: Kimberly and Laura — please advise on compensation band exception path and whether a slot-swap (Edge -> Runtime) is approvable without impacting FY budget signoff. Marcus — can you confirm we can defer the Edge hiring without service risk?

Thanks,
Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Head of Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

-----Original Message-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime headcount request — Senior Runtime Engineer (low-latency) + band exception / slot swap

Rafael — thanks for the write-up and the attachments. A few quick items from compensation/people side: 

1) Band exception: Band 5 is fine in principle but you need to include a calibrated comp justification (benchmarks for open-market offers, internal comp parity for existing Senior Runtime hires). If we push total comp up toward $300k we need exec signoff (People + Finance).

2) Slot swap: Deferring the Edge seat is plausible, but we need a written mitigation plan from Marcus (impact window, rollback plan, expected ETA for filling the Edge role). We need to avoid a situation where two teams are understaffed simultaneously.

3) Timeline: If we plan to interview and close in a 6–8 week window, provide a hiring timeline and identify preferred candidates (or confirm we need TalentOps support). 

I can provisionally approve the band exception request up to $270k total comp within People Ops delegated authority. Anything above that needs VP People + Finance approval.

Please update the request doc with the comp comps and Marcus’ mitigation plan. Copy TalentOps for sourcing.

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime headcount request — Senior Runtime Engineer (low-latency) + band exception / slot swap

Rafael — I reviewed the forecast. Short answer: we can hold off on the Edge hire for the quarter provided we accelerate two things:

- Move the Edge backlog item (region routing optimization) to a contractor engagement for the next 8–12 weeks (cost estimate in the attached sheet)
- Reserve a small fallback buffer in our infra capacity to handle any region routing regression (I propose a $40k contingency)

If TalentOps can source the Runtime senior quickly, I’m supportive of the swap. The mitigation plan will be written up in the Edge team’s backlog notes and I’ll confirm the contractor engagement by end of week.

Laura — any comments on the cost-neutral swap? From Finance side, will this require reclassifying the slot in our forecast or is a lateral swap OK?

-Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
VP Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime headcount request — Senior Runtime Engineer (low-latency) + band exception / slot swap

Thanks for the detail. Finance is OK in principle with a slot reallocation provided two things are delivered before we post the new requisition:

1) Updated cost model that shows year-to-date headcount consumption and that the swap is cost-neutral for Q3 (include contractor cost and the $40k contingency Marcus mentioned).
2) Comp justification memo that explains why this hire requires Band 5 instead of lower banding and shows comparable offers (benchmarking).

If both items are attached to the requisition, Finance will approve the reclassification and we can post the req within 48 hours. For any total comp target above $270k we’ll need VP People + CFO approval; please capture that as an escalation path in the requisition.

Rafael — please update the doc and route to People Ops (cc: TalentOps) once ready and I’ll sign off.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime headcount request — Senior Runtime Engineer (low-latency) + band exception / slot swap

Appreciate the fast reviews and the provisional approvals. Next steps I will take:

- Update runtime_hc_request_rafael_v1.pdf with comp comps and a note for escalation if we need >$270k total comp.
- Attach the updated Q3 cost workbook with contractor cost and $40k buffer.
- Confirm contractor engagement for Edge and attach statement of work.
- Loop TalentOps (Hannah Wilkes) for sourcing; cc: talentops@redwood.ai.

Target: updated package posted to the requisition queue by COB Thursday (2028-06-22).

If there are no surprises, expect the req to hit the ATS and we’ll start interviews the following week.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Head of Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
